notes.title: Update 1.10 is Out!
notes.content:
Good Sol to You, Strategists!

This update includes several improvements designed to enhance your gameplay experience:

 Animated Intro: Immerse yourself with the new animated introduction.
 Wave Variability: Encounter more diverse and challenging waves of enemies, keeping every battle fresh.
 Rebalanced Enemies: Enjoy a more balanced combat experience with reworked enemy stats and behaviours.
 Various Fixes: Bug-fixes and minor improvements.

I also wish to inform you that the Journal feature has been postponed to Update 1.20. I apologise for the delay and appreciate your understanding as I continue to refine this key aspect of the game.

These updates improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: [Update 1.00.8] Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Improvements:

 Bugfix: Resolved the 'Master Strategist' achievement issue.
 Bugfix: Fixed the blinking tooltip in certain situations.
 Progress Reset: Nullified values in stats after resetting progress.
 Game Logic: Enhanced game sequencing logic for smoother gameplay.
 Settings: Fixed jitteriness in the settings scroll.


These updates enhance stability and improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: So, What's Next? UPCOMING UPDATES!
notes.content:
Get ready for a series of awesome updates! From crucial bug fixes in v1.00.8 to new achievements, enemy behaviours, and a free DLC in v1.10, there's a lot to look forward to. Plus, v1.20 introduces the innovative 'SIMULATION' mode and global leaderboards. Stay tuned for these exciting enhancements and more!

Current Version: 1.00 (as of May 31st)
Technically: 1.00.1, where 'x' represents bugfixes and minor improvements.

Upcoming Updates

UPDATE v1.00.8:

 Bugfix: 'Master Strategist' achievement.
 Bugfix: Tooltip blinks in certain situations.
 Improvement to game sequencing logic.

Release Date: Coming days

UPDATE v1.10:

 Additional achievements.
 Enhanced high-tier enemy behaviour.
 Increased wave variability (medium, hard, and nightmare rework).
 New 'Journal' feature: Delve into The Echoes of Mars lore.
 Free DLC: Supporter's Pack, including game development materials—sketches, early artwork, development process videos, and a short film about the developer.

Release Date: June 28th, 2024

UPDATE v1.20:

 New 'SIMULATION' mode: Plan the perfect tactics for various waves without restrictions. Customize enemy waves, energy amounts, tower costs, and more!
 Ability to import/export setups for others to play with your configurations. (Steam Workshop compatibility pending.)
 New 'LEADERBOARD' section to compete globally and with friends.
 Enhanced game statistics.
 Additional achievements.

Release Date: July 28th, 2024

Until next time!

Best regards,
Georgii Antipin
Your Indie Developer
